brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: Build is one hex base piece (piece:0,0,0, half-n variant, not the full base) with no other parts or props. A half base was needed because drawers only attach to a half base's cut face; a full base offers no drawer sockets. Meshes clear.

Only one drawer is in the build (drawer:0#0,0#cut). A single base offers exactly one drawer socket (the cut face of the half base); after placing it, no further drawer sockets appear. Five drawers cannot be placed in one base under the configurator's rules.

finish.summary: I could not build a single hex base with five drawers. Drawers only seat on the cut face of a half base, and the configurator offers just one drawer position per base. The build is one half-north base with one drawer, nothing else added, and the mesh check is clear. Five drawers would need more bases or cut faces, which the brief excludes.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
